steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is the last wave of pursuers!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Aaargh!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All clear!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Confirming that it's safe over here!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Where's the enemy commander?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...Not with their main force.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The enemy is lurking... we're being followed and watched.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are they trying to wear us down until they have the perfect opportunity to strike?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion is no stranger to sneak attacks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We learned this the hard way at Chernobog.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's fall back quickly...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I can't guarantee the safety of the escape route.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We'll be in danger if they start demolishing the nearby buildings to block the road.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hurry, let's see what other routes we can take. The stealthier, the better!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Amiya, how about taking that staircase to our 4 o'clock down?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's a difficult route.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaargh! Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's an ambush! Watch out!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Continue the chase.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Don't give them any room to breathe.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Madam...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: There are some Infected kids... still in the slums.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: If possible...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I hope that you can take care of them...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Our duty is to protect Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The Infected are not considered citizens of Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, citizens or not, the Infected still belong to Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have no obligation to promise you anything, but I will perform my duty.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: After all...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: They said they used to...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's something we've always been doing.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you know why we've been searching for you?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...I'm not sure.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I can't think of any reason why you'd want me.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But I have a feeling...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: That this isn't about me...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...It's about my parents.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your father was the most famous scientist in Chernobog.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: As well as one of the most important political figures there.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Perhaps, there's something you might know...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But even if that isn't the case...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We cannot allow you to fall into Reunion's hands.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hehe. I've found you, L.G.D.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't take this personally...

steps.name: W
steps.text: But I have a very interesting plot in my hands.

steps.name: W
steps.text: To make things more entertaining, I'll need you all to participate.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Now, let us begin.
